author: Gil8060
title: Scam
content: The user reported an issue with stolen funds from their Trust Wallet. They initially requested to open a ticket and selected 'Security Issues (Report Phishing Scam/Fraudulent activity)' as the main category and 'Unauthorized Withdrawal from my Wallet/ Stolen Funds' as the subcategory. Details provided: - Trust- App/Extension Used: Mobile App (inferred from URL and app version screenshot) - Trust Wallet App Version: Version 11.53.0 (1398) - Connected ) Detailed Explanation: The user installed the Trust Wallet app, purchased BNB and USDT. They met someone virtually via WhatsApp who presented a link to a project within the app promising daily earnings. The user invested 5,000 euros with daily earnings of up to 2%. They were later presented with a 'birthday bonus' of 28,000 euros. Upon attempting to withdraw this amount, they were informed of a required German fee of approximately 5,800 euros (or USDT). Subsequently, the entire balance was debited from their wallet. The user added more USDT to cover the fee, and this amount was also debited. Later, they were informed of another fee of 2,800 dollars (US fee). The user deposited all their money, but their investment was not returned. The individual on WhatsApp continues to ask for more deposits to release investments and earnings, and even suggested inviting friends and family to invest. The user has invested around 10,000 euros and cannot recover their funds. They have screenshots of the app and WhatsApp conversations.
